P11.rationale: The page displays concrete before/after data points (24 Std. → Minuten, >200.000 €, 4 automatisierte Kernprozesse) as typographic callouts and icon-style numerals, but lacks actual chart frames or visual data plots — the numbers are real and bound to outcomes, though presented as stat callouts rather than true data visualisations.

P13.rationale: The right-hand sidebar panel uses a dark teal/slate background that creates clear atmospheric contrast against the white left column, providing intentional tonal texture and depth rather than flat blankness across the full spread.
